payload.author: claude
payload.body: FrickSessionPersisting protocol + FrickKeychainSessionStore (kSecAttrAccessibleAfterFirstUnlockThisDeviceOnly, optional accessGroup) + FrickInMemorySessionStore for tests. FrickClient auto-restores on construction, drops expired sessions (FrickSession.isExpired, unparseable expiry treated as live), and writes through on install/signOut/logout. 62 Swift tests green.
